name: io.github.ignaciohermosillacornejo/copilot-money-mcp
title: Copilot Money
description: Query and manage Copilot Money personal finances — local reads, opt-in GraphQL writes.

packageArguments.name: --db-path
packageArguments.description: Path to the Copilot Money LevelDB database. Defaults to Copilot Money's standard macOS location.

packageArguments.name: --write
packageArguments.description: Enable write tools (sends authenticated requests to Copilot Money's GraphQL API). Off by default.

packageArguments.name: --live-reads
packageArguments.description: Use GraphQL-backed live reads instead of the local LevelDB cache. Requires an authenticated browser session at app.copilot.money.

packageArguments.name: --browser
packageArguments.description: With --live-reads or --write: read the Copilot session from this browser only (chrome, edge, brave, firefox, safari, …), with no fallback to others.

packageArguments.name: --browser-profile
packageArguments.description: With --browser: read the session from this profile only, by directory name or display name.

packageArguments.name: --browser-data-dir
packageArguments.description: With --browser: use this user-data root instead of the browser's default locations. Not supported for Safari.
